parameters.query:
SELECT e.id, e.account, e.contact, e.event_type, e.campaign,
       e.metadata->>'reply_snippet' AS reply_snippet,
       coalesce(nullif((SELECT c.rep_email FROM clients c WHERE c.id = e.client_id), ''), (SELECT value FROM app_config WHERE key='rep_notification_email')) AS rep_email,
       (SELECT a.outreach_draft FROM actions a WHERE a.utm_campaign = e.campaign LIMIT 1) AS original_outreach
FROM engagement_events e
WHERE e.event_type IN ('email_reply','linkedin_reply')
  AND coalesce(e.metadata->>'triaged','') = ''
  AND coalesce(e.metadata->>'reply_snippet','') <> ''
ORDER BY e.id
LIMIT 10;
